SUNBURY, Pa. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Weis Markets, Inc. (NYSE: WMK ) Board of Directors today declared a quarterly dividend of $0.34 per share, payable on November 23, 2026, to shareholders of record as of November 9, 2026.
About Weis Markets Founded in 1912, Weis Markets, Inc. is a Mid-Atlantic food retailer operating 201 stores in Pennsylvania, Maryland, Delaware, New Jersey, New York, Virginia and West Virginia. For more information, please visit: WeisMarkets.com or Facebook.com/WeisMarkets .
